title: A Universal Theory of Spectral Propagation for Compositional Operator Networks
summary: Classical spectral theory lacks a framework for understanding how spectra propagate through compositional systems like deep neural networks, feedback control loops, and quantum circuits. This paper develops a universal theory governed by three invariants: the operadic spectrum (local spectral data), spectral derivatives (perturbation sensitivity), and interaction residue (emergent interface-generated content).
